orders.judge: Hon'ble Mr. Justice V. K. Bist
orders.text:
WPSS No.2313 of 2018 
Hon’ble V.K. Bist, J.
 Mr. Pankaj Chaturvedi, Advocate for 
the petitioner. 
 Mr. M.C. Tiwari, Deputy Advocate 
General for the State of Uttarakhand. 
 Mr. Seema Sah, Advocate for 
respondent no.2. 
 Heard learned counsel for the parties. 
 The case of the petitioner is that the 
respondents have not granted relaxation in 
the matter of the petitioner whereas 
identically situated employees were granted 
relaxation. He submits that petitioner is 
also entitled for relaxation regarding 
required length of service for being 
considered on the post of Divisional Logging 
Manager. 
 I grant four weeks’ time to the counsel 
for respondent no.2 to file counter affidavit. 
 List thereafter. 
 It is directed that retirement of the 
petitioner will not come in the way of the 
petitioner for being considered for the grant 
of notional promotion to him from 
03.11.2017. 
 
 (V.K. Bist, J.) 
 23.07.2018
Arti
